title: Sentence or phrase sort and translation sheet
subject: Arabic
source: Written for arabic/y8 lesson 20 (Sentence or phrase sort and translation sheet (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 20: These and those; 'this book' and 'this is a book'. Read the Arabic aloud, then do the tasks. Write in Arabic with all the harakat.

panels.title: Finishing the phrase
points: هٰذَا الكِتَابُ جَدِيدٌ: This book is new
تِلْكَ السَّيَّارَةُ سَرِيعَةٌ: That car is fast
هٰذِهِ الغُرْفَةُ كَبِيرَةٌ: This room is big

head: English
Arabic
Example
rows: هٰؤُلَاءِ أَقَارِبِي: these are my relatives
أُولٰئِكَ أَصْدِقَائِي: those are my friends

questions.q: Core: Translate: 1) This is a car. 2) This car is white. 3) That is a masjid. 4) That masjid is big. 5) These are my relatives.
questions.a: 1) هٰذِهِ سَيَّارَةٌ. 2) هٰذِهِ السَّيَّارَةُ بَيْضَاءُ. 3) ذٰلِكَ مَسْجِدٌ. 4) ذٰلِكَ المَسْجِدُ كَبِيرٌ. 5) هٰؤُلَاءِ أَقَارِبِي.

questions.q: Extend: Describe three things at home using 'this ... is ...' phrases.
questions.a: For example: هٰذَا البَيْتُ جَمِيلٌ. هٰذِهِ الغُرْفَةُ صَغِيرَةٌ. ذٰلِكَ البَابُ أَبْيَضُ.

questions.q: Stretch: Write a sentence with أُولٰئِكَ about people you admire (no names needed).

questions.a: B) هٰذَا البَيْتُ كَبِيرٌ. هٰذَا البَيْتُ (this house) + كَبِيرٌ (is big). Option 1 means 'This is a big house'.

questions.q: What does هٰؤُلَاءِ mean? A) these B) this C) those
Big question: what is the difference between هٰذَا كِتَابٌ and هٰذَا الكِتَابُ?
questions.a: The first is a sentence (This is a book); the second is a phrase (this book) that needs more words.
